items.why_now: The fix was merged in #11131 (coqdoc_header/coqdoc_footer fields), but the issue is still open. Closing it takes minutes.
items.first_step: Check that #11131 is in a released dune and that the docs mention the new fields, then close with a comment linking #11131.

items.action: Close as a duplicate of #14260 once it is confirmed that 3.23 reports a user error
items.why_now: A collaborator says main already gives a proper error instead of the internal error. Checking that and closing is quick.
items.first_step: Run the reporter's rocq.theory + rocq.extraction + include_subdirs reproducer on current main and check that the output is a user error, not Map.add_exn.
items.risks: If it still crashes, it becomes a real fix in Rocq rules, which is an unfamiliar area.

items.action: Fix foreign stubs overriding the user's -g0 by moving -g into :standard (revive #11942)
items.why_now: S1 silent build-correctness bug. The approach is agreed, a prototype exists that the reporter confirmed works, and the diff is a small one in dune_rules (foreign_rules.ml).
items.first_step: Read why #11942 was closed unmerged. Then rebase or redo it on main with a cram test showing that `:standard \ -g` drops -g.
items.risks: May need a dune lang version guard to keep the current flag order for older projects. #11942 may have been closed for a reason that still applies.

items.action: Fix `dune build <pkg>.opam` silently doing nothing since 3.24
items.why_now: S1 regression in the latest release with high reach. It is in opam-file generation, a familiar area, and a fix could ship in a 3.24 point release.
items.first_step: Write a cram test showing that `dune build foo.opam` exits 0 without updating the file. Then ask Alizter on the issue whether promoting or a hint pointing to `@opam` is preferred.
items.risks: No fix is agreed for the explicit-target case. The behaviour change from #14108 may have been intentional, which would limit the fix to a hint.

items.why_now: High-reach UX confusion. A maintainer's PR already exists and only needs review, plus whatever follow-up the review asks for.
items.first_step: Review #15071, rebase it if needed, check the cram test output, and ping rgrinberg to merge.
items.risks: Side questions (mention public_name? should `(modes js)` imply allow_empty?) could widen the scope. Keep them out of the PR.

items.why_now: The PR is open and only needs review or a rebase. Turning a silent no-op into an error is a small change.
items.first_step: Review #14981, rebase it on main, check the error test, and ask rgrinberg about merging.
items.risks: Projects that currently have harmless nested `dirs` entries will start to fail. Check whether a lang version guard is needed.

items.action: Fix the 3.22.0 regression where excluding a `(select)`-generated module from another stanza's modules errors
items.why_now: A regression that blocks downstream: goblint added a conflict with dune 3.22. It is in library dependencies and module selection, a familiar area.
items.first_step: Turn the reporter's reproducer into a cram test, then bisect 3.21.1..3.22.0 (anmonteiro's changes are suspected).
items.risks: Root cause unknown, and the fix may need anmonteiro's input.

items.action: Fix byte-mode linking picking installed stublibs before local ones
items.why_now: S1 correctness bug for anyone developing a library that is also installed in the switch (eio, mirage-crypto). A failing test (#10028) is already merged, and the proposed fix is local.
items.first_step: Find where the bytecode link rule emits the -I stublibs flags, order local libraries before installed ones, and update the expected output of the #10028 test.
items.risks: No maintainer has formally signed off on the approach, only proposals and support. Reordering could change other users' link behaviour.

items.action: Make `dune cache clear`/`trim` remove pre-3.22 cache layout entries
items.why_now: High reach: after an upgrade the cache grows without bound. The first step is agreed and the scope is clear.
items.first_step: Ask dibrinsofor on the issue whether they are still working on it. If not, write a cram test that seeds a legacy-layout cache dir and extend clear/trim to delete it.
items.risks: A contributor offered to do it (no PR yet). The open question about future layout versions, and the separate size-accounting problem sim642 reported, could widen the scope.

items.action: Make dune-build-info return None for versionless projects in vendored dirs
items.why_now: The approach was agreed at a dev meeting. It affects opam-monorepo and mirage users and has waited since 2023.
items.first_step: Write a cram test with a vendored dune-project without (version) inside a git repo, showing the wrong version, then implement the None case.
items.risks: There is no reproducer yet, so building one is the first piece of work.

items.action: Help land PR #16237 so `dune test --force` reruns cram tests
items.why_now: Recent, has medium reach, and a fix PR apparently exists. Cram tests are a familiar area.
items.first_step: Find PR #16237, check its author and status, and review it against a cram test showing that `--force` reruns a .t file.
items.risks: Maintainers disagree on what --force should mean (shonfeder vs Alizter), so the PR may stall on design.

items.action: Add an upgrade hint to the `select` file-format error and document the naming restriction
items.why_now: Small change in lib_dep.ml, a familiar area. It removes a confusing error that has no hint.
items.first_step: Write a cram test with a `select` branch pointing to foo/a.foo.ml, then add a hint suggesting a copy rule into a.{name}.ml.
items.risks: Low reach. A maintainer may prefer relaxing the check (as bobot suggested) over a hint.
